This is research universe expansion only, not a trading recommendation. Underfollowed expansion for the advanced packaging node points to inspection/metrology and bonding equipment vendors rather than GPU designers or foundries. Reference-lane anchors remain TSMC, leading OSATs, and HBM manufacturers because their CoWoS/HBM/chiplet capacity additions create the demand signal, but this pass prioritizes US-listed small/mid-cap or niche suppliers.
